conservative.read: This conservative plan targets a modest ~1.5%/month return, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration, aiming for steady, low-drawdown performance. Expect lower volatility but also limited upside potential.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4%/month growth, stretching for returns by leaning into leverage and concentration. plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU) to zero.
